import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { displayCurrencyText } from '@src/constants/currency';
/**
 * @deprecated 已由统一商店系统替代，请使用统一购买指令 /购买 &lt;商品编号&gt; [数量]
 *
 * 道侣商店兑换指令
 * - /道侣商店兑换 <商品编号> [数量]           → 提示二次确认
 * - /道侣商店兑换 <商品编号> [数量] 确认      → 执行兑换
 */
import { checkShopBuy, confirmShopBuy } from '@src/response-apps/companion/shopBuy/app';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { withBackendRepeatDetection } from '@src/utils/backendRepeatDetector';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const request = createBackendRequestContext(e);

  const text = e.MessageText?.trim() ?? '';
  const match = text.match(/道侣商店兑换\s+(\d+)(?:\s+(\d+))?(\s+确认)?$/);

  if (!match) {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addBold('【道侣商店兑换】');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('使用方法：/道侣商店兑换 商品编号 数量');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('示例：/道侣商店兑换 501');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  const productId = Number(match[1]);
  const count = match[2] ? Number(match[2]) : 1;
  const confirmed = Boolean(match[3]);

  const checkResult = await checkShopBuy({ messageText: e.MessageText, bid, uid, productId, count, request, confirmed });

  if (checkResult.code === 'FAIL') {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText(checkResult.data.message);

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  const { name, unitPrice, totalPrice, grantQuantity } = checkResult.data;

  if (!confirmed) {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText(`将购买：${name} ×${grantQuantity}；单价：${unitPrice} 同心值；合计：${totalPrice} 同心值`);
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText(`请发送：/道侣商店兑换 ${productId}${count > 1 ? ` ${count}` : ''} 确认`);

    const confirmCmd = `/道侣商店兑换 ${productId}${count > 1 ? ` ${count}` : ''} 确认`;

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '',
        content: md,
        footer: [{ label: '确认兑换', command: confirmCmd }]
      })
    );

    return;
  }

  const buyResult = checkResult.data.settledResult ?? (await confirmShopBuy({ bid, uid, productId, count, request }));

  if (buyResult.code === 'FAIL') {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();
    const repeatMsg = await withBackendRepeatDetection(bid, uid, e.MessageText, buyResult.data.message, request);

    md.addText(repeatMsg);

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  md.addText(`兑换成功：${buyResult.data.name}，支付${displayCurrencyText(buyResult.data.paid)}，获得×${buyResult.data.granted}`);

  void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
});
